proves.claim: A job call the board refuses BOARD_BUSY answers HTTP 503.

api.io-refusal.board-busy-503.why: Without this test a busy board answers 400 and the runner ends its whole serve instead of retrying the call.

proves.claim: A job call the board refuses JOB_WRITE_TIMEOUT answers HTTP 503, and another refusal still answers 400.

api.io-refusal.job-write-timeout-503.why: Without this test a job write that ran past its bound answers 400 and the runner ends its whole serve instead of retrying the call.

proves.claim: A claim reaching a gate job whose hop another live runner holds skips that job, leaves its lease row unchanged and takes the next job.

api.io-refusal.hop-held-leaves-lease.why: Without this test a held hop refuses the whole claim and the runner serve exits and drains for about a minute.

proves.claim: A succeeding gate job claim with the hop on makes the same number of board statements as before the hop check moved ahead of the lease write.

api.io-refusal.success-path-same-reads.why: Without this test moving the hop check could add board calls to every claim on the busiest path.
